help.title: How to search
help.intro: Type words to search everywhere, or mix in filters. Click an example to try it.

submissions.text: Text anywhere: ref no., insured, risk, MGA, broker, country, line, notes. Part of a word is enough.
submissions.and: , means AND: every part must match
submissions.pipe: | inside a filter: any of these values
submissions.exclude: - excludes (a status, a filter or a word)
submissions.fields: Filters: status, mga, broker, lob, country, ccy, uw, type, ref
submissions.numbers: Numbers: our premium in USD, share %, si (sum insured, USD); k, m, bn
submissions.dates: Dates: received, inception, expiry, bound; ranges with ..
submissions.within: Within the next (or last) N days
submissions.keywords: Keywords: overdue, expired, noresponse, mine, today, thisweek, thismonth
submissions.notes: A word that is exactly a status, MGA, line or currency (bound, USD) filters by it; anything else is searched as text.
submissions.languages: Filter names and words work in English, Russian and Uzbek: статус:связан, holat:tasdiqlandi, валюта:usd, просрочено, bugun.

counterparties.text: Text anywhere: name, country, contacts (name, e-mail, phone), notes
counterparties.type: Type: MGA, broker or cedent; | for several
counterparties.notes: A word that is exactly a type or a country (broker, Uzbekistan) filters by it; anything else is searched as text.
counterparties.languages: Words work in English, Russian and Uzbek: тип:брокер, страна:Узбекистан, неактивные.

agenda.text: Text anywhere: title, submission ref no. and insured, MGA, outcome
agenda.due: Due within the next N days (or due:2026-11-01..2026-11-30)
agenda.assignee: Everyone’s follow-ups (admin and management; or assignee:Malika)
agenda.notes: Without assignee: your own follow-ups. today, thisweek and thismonth mean «due».
agenda.languages: Words work in English, Russian and Uzbek: просрочено, срок<7d, kechikkan.

users.inactive: Only inactive users (active: only active ones)
users.notes: A word that is exactly a role (finance) filters by it.
users.languages: Words work in English, Russian and Uzbek: роль:финансы, неактивные.

reference.text: Text anywhere: code and names in every language (all three tables)
reference.inactive: Only inactive rows (active: only active ones)
reference.notes: Filters currencies, countries and lines of business at once.
reference.languages: Words work in English, Russian and Uzbek.

fx.ccy: One currency (a bare code filters by it)
fx.source: Where the rate came from: manual or cbu
fx.notes: Searches all stored rates, not only the latest shown.
fx.languages: Words work in English, Russian and Uzbek: валюта:EUR, дата>=2026-10-01.

receipts.text: Text anywhere: ref no., bank reference, payer, notes
receipts.unallocated: Receipts with money still to allocate
receipts.dates: Received from a date, amount over 10,000
receipts.notes: A bare currency code or payer name filters by it.
receipts.languages: Words work in English, Russian and Uzbek: нераспределено, валюта:EUR, taqsimlanmagan.

receivables.text: Text anywhere: ref no., insured, MGA, broker
receivables.payable: Return premium we owe MGAs (kept apart from receivables)
receivables.notes: Without status: or payable, the list shows what is still owed. A bare MGA, broker, currency or bucket filters by it.
receivables.languages: Words work in English, Russian and Uzbek: просрочено>45, корзина:61-90, qaytarish.

claims.text: Text anywhere: claim no., cedent ref., risk ref., insured, MGA, broker, cause, location, line
claims.cashcall: Claims with a cash call due
claims.dol: Losses in the first half of 2026
claims.mga: One MGA and line of business
claims.notes: A bare status, MGA, line or currency filters by it.
claims.languages: Words work in English, Russian and Uzbek: статус:открыт, крупный, убыток:2026.

binders.text: Text anywhere: binder ref., MGA, broker, submission ref., notes, territories
binders.missing: Binders with a bordereau past its due date
binders.notes: A bare status, MGA or currency filters by it; late and missing look at the bordereaux owed.
binders.languages: Words work in English, Russian and Uzbek: статус:действует, просрочен.

ai_usage.status: Requests that failed or were declined
ai_usage.text: Text anywhere: user, file name, model, error
ai_usage.notes: A bare status or kind filters by it.
ai_usage.languages: Words work in English, Russian and Uzbek: статус:ошибка.

rcp.noneHint: Record money as it arrives — New receipt.
rcp.newHint: Record the money received, then say which installments it pays. Anything left stays unallocated until you allocate it.
rcp.fillFirst: Fill in the payer, currency and amount to allocate the receipt.
rcp.confirmRemove: Remove this allocation? The installment becomes unpaid by this amount again.
rcp.allocateHint: The payer’s open installments are suggested, oldest due first. Across currencies, enter the rate — the preview shows what lands on the installment.
rcp.noneYet: Add an installment below, or auto-allocate.
rcp.noOpenForPayer: This payer has no open installments — add one from another payer below, or record the receipt unallocated.
rcp.useReference: Use the stored rate on the received date
rcp.inverted: This looks inverted: it is close to 1 ÷ the stored rate. Enter {{to}} per 1 {{from}}.
rcp.far: More than 10 % away from the stored rate — check it.

err.gone: This installment can no longer take money.

rcp.addOther: Add an installment from another payer…
rcp.noReference: No stored rate for this date — enter the rate yourself.

claim.offsetHint: The amount is set against {{mga}}'s open premium: a receipt from the MGA is recorded and allocated, with the usual rules (a rate across currencies).

binder.formHint: The MGA’s authority: period, lines and their limits, territories, our share, deductions and the bordereaux it owes.
binder.noneHint: Create a binder for an MGA, then upload its bordereaux.
binder.lobsHint: Tick the lines the MGA may write; a limit (100 %, {{ccy}}) applies to that line only.
binder.territoriesHint: Countries the MGA may write in; none ticked = anywhere.
binder.aggregateHint: At 100 %; capacity used counts the risk bordereaux.
binder.capacityNoRate: {{count}} risks in another currency without a rate
binder.notBound: Not bound yet: premium and claims bordereaux wait for it
binder.dueDaysHint: 30 = due 30 days after the month (or quarter) ends
binder.premiumNeedsBound: Premium is kept on the bound binder submission: its schedule and every premium bordereau.
binder.pickHint: The MGA’s binder this risk is written under

v.lobs: Tick at least one line of business

bdx.fileHint: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, up to 10 MB; kept as a document

bdx.headerRowHint: The row with the column titles
bdx.saveTemplate: Save this mapping for the MGA

bdx.statedTotalHint: From the bordereau’s total line or cover letter
bdx.totalsDiffer: The MGA states {{stated}}, the lines add up to {{computed}}

effect.risk: Risk lines count toward the binder’s capacity; at 80 % and 100 % management and the underwriter are told.
effect.premium: One premium installment per currency: our share ({{share}} %), commission and brokerage deducted, due {{days}} days after the period.
effect.claims: Each line finds its claim by the cedent’s claim ref. (or opens one); the reserve moves to our share ({{share}} %) of paid + outstanding.
